proposal.summary: Authenticated users with at least operator privileges can upload a specially crafted SNMP configuration file via the Web UI or administrative CLI on Cisco ESA and SMA, which may lead to command execution as root and full system compromise.
proposal.affected_product: Cisco Secure Email Gateway (ESA) and Cisco Secure Email and Web Manager (SMA); versions not specified
proposal.cwe_quote: The vulnerability is due to the processing of a specially crafted SNMP configuration file.

AV.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by authenticating to the targeted device and uploading a specially crafted SNMP configuration file

PR.quote: The attacker has to have a valid user credential with at least a [[privilege of operator - validate actual name]].
